Fid: exact freeze replay of AST+theta under SymbolicArbiter; expect ~1.0 for symbolic arms
FRS_k: fraction of eval customers with identical membership bits across k successive non-vacuous edits (add/drop/threshold); vacuous |Δmem|<0.001 retried
mean_abs_delta_frac: mean absolute membership change fraction per edit
jaccard_to_rfm: max Jaccard of m_A vs any RFM quintile or propensity-band mask
portfolio_novelty: mean novelty over audiences in P
coverage: share of eval users in at least one discovered audience
NDCG: N/A — audience bits are not an item ranking score
